meals.title: Keto Spinach & Cheese Omelette
steps: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over low heat.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Pour in the eggs and let them set gently.
Add spinach and cheddar to one half.
Fold and cook until the cheese melts.

meals.title: Veggie Tofu Scramble
steps: Crumble the tofu with a fork.
Saute onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add tofu and turmeric; cook 4-5 minutes.
Fold in spinach until wilted; season.

meals.title: Greek Yogurt & Berry Bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with blueberries, almonds and chia seeds.

meals.title: Banana Walnut Oatmeal
steps: Warm the cooked oats with almond milk.
Top with sliced banana and walnuts.

meals.title: Grilled Chicken Salad
steps: Grill the chicken and slice it.
Toss lettuce, tomato and cucumber with olive oil.
Top with chicken and crumbled feta.

meals.title: Baked Salmon & Greens
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C.
Toss vegetables with olive oil and garlic.
Roast salmon and vegetables 15 minutes.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon.

meals.title: Chicken & Rice Power Bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Grill and slice the chicken.
Steam the broccoli.
Assemble the bowl and drizzle with olive oil.

meals.title: Beef & Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Heat coconut oil in a wok on high.
Sear the beef strips; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables and garlic 3-4 minutes.
Return beef and toss to combine.

meals.title: Hearty Lentil Soup
steps: Saute onion, carrot and garlic in olive oil.
Add lentils, tomato, cumin and water.
Simmer 20-25 minutes until tender.

meals.title: Chickpea Curry
steps: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add tomato and spices; cook down.
Stir in chickpeas and coconut milk.
Simmer 12-15 minutes.

meals.title: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
steps: Cook and cool the quinoa.
Dice cucumber and tomato.
Toss everything with olive oil and olives.

meals.title: Tuna Avocado Bowl
steps: Flake the tuna over lettuce.
Add sliced avocado.
Dress with olive oil and lemon.

meals.title: Turkey Lettuce Wraps
steps: Cook and season the turkey.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.
Top with tomato and avocado.

meals.title: Paleo Roast Chicken & Veg
steps: Heat oven to 200 C.
Toss chicken and vegetables with olive oil and garlic.
Roast 25-30 minutes.

meals.title: Tofu & Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Press and cube the tofu.
Sear tofu in coconut oil; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables and garlic.
Return tofu and toss.

meals.title: Berry Protein Smoothie
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth.

meals.title: Cottage Cheese & Fruit
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with sliced peach and walnuts.

meals.title: Veggie Whole-Wheat Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Saute zucchini, tomato and garlic in olive oil.
Toss with pasta and basil.

samplePlan.note: Illustrative structure. Runtime plans are filtered by the chosen diet and liked foods.
